jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The Fulfilment Tech Family builds the systems that power Grab's marketplaces across Southeast Asia. We design real-time, distributed systems and Machine Learning (ML) solutions that process hundreds of millions of requests each day. Our work drives supply allocation, pricing, and order matching for millions of users and driver-partners.Our mission is three-fold: Deliver products that work for our driver-partners Meet consumer demand, regardless of conditions Build marketplaces that balance experience and cost for everyone involved We are looking for a Senior Principal Data Scientist to lead our shift toward automated marketplace optimization. You'll advance how we use data and ML to automate pricing, dispatch, and supply management decisions. Get to Know the Role This is a Senior Principal individual contributor role where you'll build the foundation for autonomous, learning-driven marketplace systems. You'll work at the intersection of reinforcement learning, large language models, and production systems that operate at scale. Your work centres on two areas: Reinforcement Learning (RL) Systems: You'll develop systems that jointly optimize pricing, dispatching, and supply repositioning. You'll build decision agents that handle multiple objectives and adapt when real-world conditions change. LLM-Based Behavioural Intelligence: You'll architect systems using fine-tuned language models to predict, explain, and simulate user decision-making at scale. These models will power the next generation of marketplace automation. You'll serve as the technical lead for a small team, guiding both research direction and production implementation. You'll report to the Head of Data Science and work from Grab's One-North Singapore office. The Critical Tasks You will Perform You will: Design and implement end-to-end RL systems that combine model-based RL, offline RL, simulation, and online learning into a unified training pipeline. This includes creating state representations and reward structures that balance short-term results with long-term outcomes. Build latent world models and marketplace state representations that capture supply-demand interactions, location-based patterns, and behavioural signals from users and drivers. Develop systems that optimize across multiple marketplace levers simultaneously—pricing, dispatching, and supply repositioning—to expand the set of achievable outcomes for the business. Create policy evaluation frameworks and establish monitoring systems that allow safe deployment of new decision-making policies in production. Fine-tune open-source large language models on domain-specific data to build capabilities for prediction, reasoning, and simulation within marketplace applications. Design and implement training strategies for language models, including supervised fine-tuning, preference-based alignment, and iterative improvement methods. Work with data engineers and backend engineers to integrate RL and LLM systems into real-time production environments serving millions of users. What Essential Skills You Will Need You have PhD in Computer Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or related field with at least 10 years of experience — to lead complex technical initiatives spanning research and production systems. You are proficient in RL fundamentals — including Markov Decision Processes, stochastic control, and reward design trade-offs. You'll apply these to build closed-loop systems that make sequential decisions in the marketplace. You have experience building production ML/ RL systems with online learning or simulation-based optimization — to deploy models that learn and adapt in real-time environments. You have knowledge in world models and sequential modelling — including latent dynamic models (RNNs, transformers, state-space models) and representation learning for complex systems. You'll use these to model marketplace dynamics accurately. You have hands-on experience fine-tuning large language models in production — including supervised fine-tuning and at least one preference-based alignment method (RLHF, DPO, or GRPO). You'll apply parameter-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA, or PEFT) and understand their trade-offs in accuracy, memory, and cost. You can design evaluation frameworks for generative models — including metrics for factual accuracy and reasoning quality. You'll use these to validate model outputs before deployment. You have experience with distributed training frameworks — such as DeepSpeed, FSDP, or Megatron-LM. You'll use these to train large models efficiently across multiple GPUs or nodes. You are proficient in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow) — to implement models and integrate with production codebases. You have experience with scalable computing platforms — such as Spark or Ray. You'll use these to process large datasets and distribute training workloads. You can translate ambiguous business problems into concrete modelling tasks — to identify what can be solved with ML/RL and define the scope, data requirements, and success criteria. jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The Fulfilment Tech Family builds distributed systems and machine learning platforms that power Grab's multi-sided marketplace across Southeast Asia. We process hundreds of millions of real-time requests each day to manage supply allocation, dispatch, order matching, and dynamic pricing across mobility and deliveries. Our mission is to balance customer reliability, driver-partner earnings, and operational efficiency under volatile real-world conditions. We foster a collaborative, research-to-production culture focused on scalable algorithmic impact. Get to Know the Role As Senior Principal Data Scientist, you will be the senior individual contributor lead architecting Grab's next generation of autonomous marketplace decisioning systems. Working at the intersection of reinforcement learning, latent world models, and generative AI, you will guide technical strategy and translate research into production systems serving millions of users. You will be the technical lead for a specialised team of scientists and engineers, reporting directly to the Head of Data Science. You will also base full-time onsite at Grab's One-North office in Singapore. If you are passionate about pioneering real-time, learning-driven marketplace systems at massive scale, join us! The Critical Tasks You Will Perform You will architect and implement end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines (offline RL, model-based RL, and simulation) to jointly automate pricing, dispatch, and supply repositioning decisions. You will design latent world models and spatio-temporal marketplace state representations that capture complex supply-demand interactions and multi-temporal levers. You will establish formal off-policy evaluation (OPE) frameworks, conservative value estimation baselines, and safety guardrails to de-risk live deployment in production. You will build behavioural simulation systems using fine-tuned open-source large language models (LLMs) to forecast and simulate user and partner decision dynamics. You will partner with backend, streaming, and platform engineering teams to deploy low-latency, closed-loop decision agents into high-throughput production environments. You will leverage modern Generative AI development tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate prototyping, code quality, testing, and technical documentation across the team. What Essential Skills You Will Need You have a PhD in Computer Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline with at least 10 years of post-degree experience leading complex machine learning research and production initiatives (or Master's degree with at least 12 years of equivalent experience). You are proficient in reinforcement learning foundations, including Markov Decision Processes, stochastic control, offline RL, and reward shaping for sequential multi-objective decision systems. You have proven experience deploying production ML/RL systems operating under real-time constraints, non-stationary data, and distribution shifts. You have hands-on expertise with large language model adaptation and alignment, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), parameter-efficient methods (LoRA/QLoRA), and preference tuning (RLHF, DPO, or GRPO). You have hands-on proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and distributed training/compute platforms such as Ray, DeepSpeed, FSDP, or Megatron-LM. We are building a user-centric intelligence capability that helps Grabbers, managers, People teams, and business leaders understand what is happening, identify what matters, and take effective action. You will build AI systems and agents that automate People Science workflows, develop an organisational listening engine that turns signals into action, and advise People and business leaders on real problems. This is a hands-on role requiring research rigour, analytical judgement, and user-centric product thinking. You will report to the Head, People Science. Democratise people data through accessible AI agents, self-service tools, and data products that help non-technical users make better decisions. Product coverage spans Deposits, Investments, Cards (Debit and Credit), Consumer Payments, Wallet, and GrabKios / Digital Goods / Agent Network. jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The Grab Support Analytics team powers customer-centric decision-making across Grab's ecosystem. We partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business teams to understand support touchpoints, reduce customer friction, and improve operational resolution efficiency. Our culture is collaborative, curious, and deeply grounded in data rigour and experimentation. Get to Know the Role We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist / Senior Product Analyst to help our product and business teams make data-driven, objective decisions and lead the design of controlled experiments. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, and Data Scientists to define data requirements, identify key success metrics, and translate complex datasets into actionable insights. You will also evaluate the feasibility of new product ideas and customer support initiatives to maximize user satisfaction and operational impact. You will report to the Product Analytics Manager and work onsite at the Grab Singapore One North office. If you are passionate about applying analytical rigour and experimentation to solve real-world problems at scale, apply today! The Critical Tasks You Will Perform You will partner with Product, Business, Engineering, and Design teams to define data requirements, establish core KPIs, and deliver data-backed recommendations on new product feature feasibility. You will design, implement, and analyze rigorous controlled experiments (A/B testing and quasi-experiments) to validate product hypotheses and guide product launch decisions. You will develop and maintain analytical frameworks, statistical models, and data pipelines to evaluate support workflows and user journeys. You will proactively monitor key business and operational metrics, conducting deep-dive root cause analyses (RCA) on shifts and anomalies to surface rapid, actionable interventions. You will translate complex analytical findings into clear, executive-ready dashboards, reports, and strategic narratives for leadership. You will leverage Generative AI (GAI) and emerging productivity tools to optimize analytical workflows, automate query and code generation, and improve reporting efficiency. What Essential Skills You Will Need You have at least 4 years of experience in data-related or quantitative fields such as Product Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or Mathematics. You are fluent in SQL and proficient in Python, R, or equivalent programming languages for statistical analysis and data manipulation. You have hands-on experience handling large-scale datasets, distributed computing environments, and maintaining robust data transformation workflows. You have solid statistical knowledge and proven practical experience designing, executing, and evaluating controlled online experiments (A/B testing). You are proficient in developing self-serve dashboards and visualisations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Superset. You have experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.
